#001

Link does not have a discernible accessible name

link-name  •  UF-00001
High Custom + axe Links WCAG 2.4.4 Link Purpose (In Context) / 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value Level A High - detected by both engines
View issue details and remediation

Why this matters

Screen-reader users may encounter a link without being told what it does or where it goes.

Location

DOM selector: .navbar-brand | Ownership: page_content | Actionability: directly_reviewable

Affected HTML 

<a class="navbar-brand mr-0" href="https://www.sau.ac.bd/">
                <img src="image/sau-logo.png" alt="" class="img-fluid logo">
            </a>

axe automated evidence 

Fix all of the following:
  Element is in tab order and does not have accessible text

Fix any of the following:
  Element does not have text that is visible to screen readers
  aria-label attribute does not exist or is empty
  aria-labelledby attribute does not exist, references elements that do not exist or references elements that are empty
  Element has no title attribute

Custom scanner evidence

Link has no accessible name. Add meaningful link text, aria-label, or image alt text.

axe description

Ensure links have discernible text

Recommended change

Provide meaningful visible link text or another valid accessible name. Icon-only links should expose a concise accessible name describing their action or destination.

Suggested code pattern 

<a aria-label="Describe link destination" class="navbar-brand mr-0" href="https://www.sau.ac.bd/">
<img alt="" class="img-fluid logo" src="image/sau-logo.png"/>
</a>

Replace placeholder text with wording that correctly reflects the real page context.

Manual review

Required: Yes

Verify the final computed accessible name in the rendered browser accessibility tree.

Reference

Open axe rule documentation

empty-heading  •  UF-00007
Low Custom + axe Headings WCAG 2.4.6 Headings and Labels Level AA High - detected by both engines
View issue details and remediation

Why this matters

An empty heading creates an unhelpful navigation point for users who navigate content by headings.

Location

DOM selector: .text-right | Ownership: page_content | Actionability: directly_reviewable

Affected HTML 

<h5 class="mb-0 text-right">
                    <a href="javascript: void(0)" class="close-icon" onclick="hideSlidableMenu()"><i class="fas fa-times"></i></a>
                </h5>

axe automated evidence 

Fix any of the following:
  Element does not have text that is visible to screen readers
  aria-label attribute does not exist or is empty
  aria-labelledby attribute does not exist, references elements that do not exist or references elements that are empty
  Element has no title attribute

Custom scanner evidence

Heading has no accessible text.

axe description

Ensure headings have discernible text

Recommended change

Remove the heading if it has no purpose or provide meaningful text describing the associated section.

Suggested code pattern 

<h5 class="mb-0 text-right">Describe this section</h5>

Replace placeholder text with wording that correctly reflects the real page context.

Manual review

Required: Yes

#008

Image does not have an appropriate text alternative

image-alt  •  UF-00008
Critical Custom + axe Images WCAG 1.1.1 Non-text Content Level A High - detected by both engines
View issue details and remediation

Why this matters

Users who cannot perceive the image may not receive the information or function communicated by it.

Location

DOM selector: .pt-3 > .afflition_main.container > .position-relative > .affilition_mid.slick-initialized.slick-slider > .slick-list.draggable > .slick-track > .slick-current[data-slick-index="0"][aria-hidden="false"] > div > .affilition_mid_single > a[href=""] > .afflition_slider_component | Ownership: page_content | Actionability: directly_reviewable

Affected HTML 

<img class="afflition_slider_component" src="./uploads/affialiation/affialiation_17_1758007237.jpg">

axe automated evidence 

Fix any of the following:
  Element does not have an alt attribute
  aria-label attribute does not exist or is empty
  aria-labelledby attribute does not exist, references elements that do not exist or references elements that are empty
  Element has no title attribute
  Element's default semantics were not overridden with role="none" or role="presentation"

Custom scanner evidence

Image does not have an alt attribute.

axe description

Ensure <img> elements have alternative text or a role of none or presentation

Recommended change

Determine whether the image is informative, functional, or decorative. Informative images should have concise alternative text describing their purpose. Decorative images should normally use alt="".

Suggested code pattern 

<img alt="[Describe the image purpose]" class="afflition_slider_component" src="./uploads/affialiation/affialiation_17_1758007237.jpg"/>

Replace placeholder text with wording that correctly reflects the real page context.

Manual review

Required: Yes

The correct alternative depends on the purpose and surrounding context of the image.

Reference

Open axe rule documentation

  Element has no title attribute

#045

Image has an empty alternative

empty_alt  •  UF-00045
Medium Custom Images WCAG 1.1.1 Non-text Content Level A Contextual/manual review Context-aware recommendation
View issue details and remediation

Why this matters

Empty alt text is appropriate for decorative images but may hide meaningful content when used on informative images.

Location

DOM selector: html > body.position-relative > header.navbar-area > div.container.nav-container > nav.navbar.navbar-expand > a.navbar-brand.mr-0 > img.img-fluid.logo | Ownership: page_content | Actionability: directly_reviewable

Affected HTML 

<img alt="" class="img-fluid logo" src="image/sau-logo.png"/>

Custom scanner evidence

Image has an empty alt attribute.

Recommended change

Keep alt="" if the image is decorative. If the image communicates information or performs a function, replace the empty value with meaningful alternative text.

Context-Aware Recommendation

Visually inspect the image. If it communicates information related to “sylhet agricultural university bangladesh”, replace alt="" with a concise description of what the image actually communicates. If it is purely decorative, keep alt="".

Why this suggestion was made: The surrounding parent text identifies the content context, but textual context alone cannot determine what the image visually contains.

Evidence: parent text Context confidence: low Language: en Decision: EMPTY_ALT_CONTEXT_AVAILABLE

Recommended action: verify decorative or informative

Visual review required

The surrounding text provides contextual evidence, but the image itself must be inspected before final alternative text is written.

Human verification: Required before implementation.

This recommendation was generated by the proposed deterministic contextual decision engine. Context confidence describes the strength of the extracted contextual evidence, not WCAG conformance certainty.

Suggested code pattern 

<img alt="[Describe image if informative]" class="img-fluid logo" src="image/sau-logo.png"/>

Replace placeholder text with wording that correctly reflects the real page context.

Manual review

Required: Yes

Automation cannot reliably determine whether the image is decorative or informative.

Medium Custom Images WCAG 1.1.1 Non-text Content Level A Contextual/manual review Context-aware recommendation
View issue details and remediation

Why this matters

Empty alt text is appropriate for decorative images but may hide meaningful content when used on informative images.

Location

DOM selector: div#pills-news > div.news-slider.news-slider-1:nth-of-type(1) > div.pr-1.pr-md-3:nth-of-type(78) > div.tab-slider-item.mb-2 > img.img-fluid | Ownership: page_content | Actionability: directly_reviewable

Affected HTML 

<img alt="" class="img-fluid" src="uploads/news/news_banner_3067_1771337086.jpg"/>

Custom scanner evidence

Image has an empty alt attribute.

Recommended change

Keep alt="" if the image is decorative. If the image communicates information or performs a function, replace the empty value with meaningful alternative text.

Context-Aware Recommendation

Visually inspect the image. If it communicates information related to “গণপ্রজাতন্ত্রী বাংলাদেশ সরকারের মাননীয় প্রধানমন্ত্রী হিসেবে জনাব তারেক রহমান দায়িত্ব গ্রহণ করায় সিলেট কৃষি বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ের পক্ষ থেকে উষ্ণ অভিনন্দন”, replace alt="" with a concise description of what the image actually communicates. If it is purely decorative, keep alt="".

Why this suggestion was made: The surrounding nearby heading identifies the content context, but textual context alone cannot determine what the image visually contains.

Evidence: nearby heading Context confidence: medium Language: bn Decision: EMPTY_ALT_CONTEXT_AVAILABLE

Recommended action: verify decorative or informative

Visual review required

The surrounding text provides contextual evidence, but the image itself must be inspected before final alternative text is written.

Human verification: Required before implementation.

This recommendation was generated by the proposed deterministic contextual decision engine. Context confidence describes the strength of the extracted contextual evidence, not WCAG conformance certainty.

Suggested code pattern 

<img alt="[Describe image if informative]" class="img-fluid" src="uploads/news/news_banner_3067_1771337086.jpg"/>

Replace placeholder text with wording that correctly reflects the real page context.

Manual review

Required: Yes

Automation cannot reliably determine whether the image is decorative or informative.

View issue details and remediation

Why this matters

Empty alt text is appropriate for decorative images but may hide meaningful content when used on informative images.

Location

DOM selector: div#pills-news > div.news-slider.news-slider-1:nth-of-type(1) > div.pr-1.pr-md-3:nth-of-type(165) > div.tab-slider-item.mb-2 > img.img-fluid | Ownership: page_content | Actionability: directly_reviewable

Affected HTML 

<img alt="" class="img-fluid" src="uploads/news/news_banner_2975_1756745778.jpg"/>

Custom scanner evidence

Image has an empty alt attribute.

Recommended change

Keep alt="" if the image is decorative. If the image communicates information or performs a function, replace the empty value with meaningful alternative text.

Context-Aware Recommendation

Visually inspect the image. If it communicates information related to “বাংলাদেশের টেকসই অর্থনীতির রূপকার সাবেক অর্থ ও পরিকল্পনা মন্ত্রী এম সাইফুর রহমান”, replace alt="" with a concise description of what the image actually communicates. If it is purely decorative, keep alt="".

Why this suggestion was made: The surrounding nearby heading identifies the content context, but textual context alone cannot determine what the image visually contains.

Evidence: nearby heading Context confidence: medium Language: bn Decision: EMPTY_ALT_CONTEXT_AVAILABLE

Recommended action: verify decorative or informative

Visual review required

The surrounding text provides contextual evidence, but the image itself must be inspected before final alternative text is written.

Human verification: Required before implementation.

This recommendation was generated by the proposed deterministic contextual decision engine. Context confidence describes the strength of the extracted contextual evidence, not WCAG conformance certainty.

Suggested code pattern 

<img alt="[Describe image if informative]" class="img-fluid" src="uploads/news/news_banner_2975_1756745778.jpg"/>

Replace placeholder text with wording that correctly reflects the real page context.

Required: Yes

#422

Link does not have a discernible accessible name

link-name  •  UF-00422
High axe Links WCAG 2.4.4 Link Purpose (In Context) / 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value Level A Axe automated finding
View issue details and remediation

Why this matters

Screen-reader users may encounter a link without being told what it does or where it goes.

Location

DOM selector: .notice-area > a[href="#"]:nth-child(3) | Ownership: page_content | Actionability: directly_reviewable

Affected HTML 

<a href="#">
                                            </a>

axe automated evidence 

Fix all of the following:
  Element is in tab order and does not have accessible text

Fix any of the following:
  Element does not have text that is visible to screen readers
  aria-label attribute does not exist or is empty
  aria-labelledby attribute does not exist, references elements that do not exist or references elements that are empty
  Element has no title attribute

axe description

Ensure links have discernible text

Recommended change

Provide meaningful visible link text or another valid accessible name. Icon-only links should expose a concise accessible name describing their action or destination.

Suggested code pattern 

<a aria-label="Describe link destination" href="#">
</a>

Replace placeholder text with wording that correctly reflects the real page context.

Manual review

Required: Yes

Verify the final computed accessible name in the rendered browser accessibility tree.

Reference

Open axe rule documentation

Fix any of the following:
  Element does not have text that is visible to screen readers
  aria-label attribute does not exist or is empty
  aria-labelledby attribute does not exist, references elements that do not exist or references elements that are empty
  Element has no title attribute

axe description

Ensure links have discernible text

Recommended change

Provide meaningful visible link text or another valid accessible name. Icon-only links should expose a concise accessible name describing their action or destination.

Suggested code pattern 

<a aria-label="Describe link destination" href="#">
</a>

Replace placeholder text with wording that correctly reflects the real page context.

Manual review

Required: Yes

Verify the final computed accessible name in the rendered browser accessibility tree.

  aria-labelledby attribute does not exist, references elements that do not exist or references elements that are empty
  Element has no title attribute
  Element's default semantics were not overridden with role="none" or role="presentation"

axe description

Ensure select element has an accessible name

Recommended change

Select element must have an accessible name

Manual review

Required: Yes

No dedicated remediation template has yet been defined for this rule.

Methodology note: Automated accessibility testing can identify many important problems, but it cannot establish complete WCAG conformance. Context-dependent and incomplete findings require human review. Context-aware recommendations are produced by deterministic rules using extracted local page context and should be verified before implementation.
